text:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: [ALERT] Suspicious auth-rate spike detected for /v1/infer (us-west-2). ~1.2k req/min from ~420 IPs. Pattern: same bearer tokens seen from many IPs. Severity: paging.
sam: I'm on it, looking through edge logs now.
maria: pulling WAF & edge logs, filtering by X-Request-Id. any customer impact?
jordan: dashboard shows elevated 429s for three tenants (acct-123, acct-456, acct-789). No broad 5xx increase.
sam: logs show repeated Authorization headers with identical tokens across distinct IPs — indicates token replay/possible exfil.
maria: starting temporary IP blocklist for IPs with >20 distinct tokens in 5m. deploying rule to CDN/WAF.
sam: should we rotate service keys for internal infer clients (svc-infer-*)? if tokens leaked, rotate and failover.
infra-bot: Runbook: https://internal.runbooks/redwood/auth-replay — recommended: block, rotate keys, scrub logs, assess PII.
maria: executing: ``edgectl deny-ip --source-list /tmp/sus_ips.txt`` now (pushing to edge).
sam: kicking key rotation: ``rbctl keys rotate --prefix svc-infer- --env prod --async``. ETA per key ~2m. monitoring.
jordan: prepping customer comms draft, holding until legal signs off.
legal: do not notify customers yet. collect token samples & redacted contexts first; need to confirm PII exposure before external notification.
sec-lead: priority: 1) stop active replay, 2) rotate compromised keys, 3) scrub logs with raw auth headers, 4) confirm scope and PII. keep succinct timeline.
maria: starting S3 scrub job to redact Authorization headers in prod logs: ``s3-scrub --prefix logs/ingest --pattern Authorization``. copying suspect bundle to quarantine bucket.
sam: rotation status: 3/7 svc-infer keys rotated successfully, no rollout errors so far.
oncall-next: I'll take the pager for the next 2h — will watch blocklist and rotation job.
jordan: impact estimate: 3 customers saw degraded throughput for ~8-12 minutes while edge rules applied; no confirmed data exfil yet.
maria: found one log bundle in tmp indexer: raw tokens were forwarded to third-party indexer endpoint (s3://tmp/indexer-dump). quarantining and requesting retention hold.
legal: preserve that bundle for chain-of-custody. do NOT delete until we confirm. request logs from indexer vendor if available.
sec-lead: escalating to Sev2. schedule postmortem and assign action items: sam (lead), maria (mitigation), jordan (customer comms), legal (notice decision).
sam: ack. I'll draft timeline and actions.
pagerbot: Severity updated to Sev2 by sec-lead. Pager muted for oncall-next at 1710745900.
maria: also rotating S3 ingestion keys used by the indexer and removing old archived bundles from public access.
jordan: added affected tenants to the internal incident ticket and notified CSMs (pending legal OK).
sam: handing off active pager to oncall-next; I'll remain available if rotation fails.
oncall-next: ack — monitoring metrics & WAF logs look stable; will escalate if recurrence.
legal: standing by for PII assessment results. do not publish external comms until we have confirmation.
maria: follow-up: scrub job found ~1200 headers; redaction job started, progress ~45%.
jordan: thanks team — will update ticket with final affected accounts and timeline once scrub/rotation complete.
sam: will prepare post-incident summary and action list after containment.
legal: please preserve all relevant artifacts and tag the incident packet.
sec-lead: good work. keep updates concise in thread.
notes: short live-mitigation Slack thread: blocking, rotations, scrub, legal hold, handoff
